title: Cop On Ganesh Immersion Duty In Hyderabad Knocked Down By Bike, Dies
summary: According to police, an unidentified man on a motorcycle allegedly hit the Sub-Inspector and fled the spot. Venkanna lost his balance and fell on the road.
